2: At the beginning of Hormanita (etc.; this wording is found at the beginning of Tikun 5 and at the end of Tikun 18, folio 37b) – this passage is obscure, and to understand it we shall preface it with a compilation drawn from the disciples of the Ari, of blessed memory, and from the works of Shabar Yosef and Rabbi Yisrael Sarug, of blessed memory. Know that the Torah was created from the 271 gates, as stated in the Sefer Yetzirah, which are the 21 letters of the alphabet excluding the 110. There are 271 inner gates beginning with the letter ‘A’ and 271 outer gates beginning with the letter ‘T’; and twice 271 equals a path, which is a gate through which no evil can enter , and it is called ‘Nativ’, in which the second root, the aforementioned 271, is found. And when the Infinite One, blessed be He, wished to reveal His greatness and do good to others, He fashioned for Himself a garment from the light of His very essence, which is the Torah; it is composed of 271 inner gates and 271 outer gates, as is the rule: ‘His garment is from Him and within Him’. And He, blessed be He, contracted Himself within His garment. Thereafter, the Infinite One contracted His light and left a void. Nothing remained therein save the imprint of the Infinite One, and the aforementioned garment was folded, its lower half upon its upper half. And by the power of the five Gevurot of Menatzpech, the garment was divided into two; it was initially in the secret of the closed ‘Mem’, and through the aforementioned five Gevurot it was divided into two and became like the two ‘Nun’s’ of ‘Vayihi b’neso’ah ha-Aron’ [And it came to pass when the Ark set out], and the lower half of the garment was folded into the upper half. And know that this garment was woven from RLA gates on the front and RLA gates on the back, and was also woven from the four letters of YHVH, as follows # )( And when the lower half was folded over the upper half, the ‘lamed’—which is half of ‘da’at’—rose opposite the ‘alef’, and the ‘mem’ rose opposite the ‘bet’; and so it was with all of them, and this is the ‘Alfa-Beta d’Albam’; likewise, the ‘vav’ and ‘heh’ of ‘YHVH’ rose opposite ‘YH’; and thus the name ‘MH’ clothed ‘LAB’, and the name ‘BN’ clothed ‘G’. It is found that the Yod of the final ‘Y’ in the filling of ‘S’G’ has no counterpart, because the name ‘Ben’ contains only nine letters; and this is the secret of what our sages said: ‘Shabbat said before the Holy One, Blessed be He: “To all You have given a counterpart,” etc.’ And He replied to her: ‘The Congregation of Israel shall be your counterpart.’ That is to say, the Great Shabbat is Binah, and she is ‘S’G’; hence the question. And the answer is that all the worlds will be through Binah, and she is the artisan of them all—she is the final ‘Y’ of ‘S’G’. And within this void there are two records: the first is the record of the Infinite Light, called the Primordial Light; and the second is the record of the garment. It is referred to as the ‘point’, which is the letter Yod, for it is like a point within the great light of the record of the Infinite.

And the Holy One, blessed be He, signalled to the final Yud of the letter ‘S’ that it should descend and illuminate the vacant space; and so it did—it descended and illuminated, and that illumination almost filled the entire vacant space, whereupon it returned to its place; and it became known that every return is a judgement. Thus, from that return, a certain root came into being, and within that root was gathered the light that it had illuminated upon its descent. And it became the sphere of Tahiro, which is the Primordial Man. For ‘Tahiro Ilaya’ is the Primordial Air, and ‘Tahiro’ simply is the Primordial Man. And the Holy One, blessed be He, alluded to the ‘K’ of ‘K’T D’Alb’m’, which is the end of the garment, and caressed it upon its face. And the ‘Y’ of ‘S’G’ descended and settled between the end of the garment and the Tahiro; and as she descended for the first time into the primordial air, she took the imprint of the garment, which is the ‘Y’ of air. And when she took it to assist her as the Yod departed from the air, the light returned as it had been called in the beginning; and this is the secret of ‘the light that already was’, and this is what is written in the Zohar: ‘The Yod departed from the air and the light remained.’ And now that she had descended between the end of the garment and the Tahiro, her hands were weakened and she lacked the strength to contain the point. The imprint of the garment, which is the Yud of Air, descended and became a surrounding light upon the Tahiro; and the part closest to the Yud of Sag is called ‘Primordial Air’. And the part that surrounds and touches the Tahiro is called ‘Adam Kadma’a Sitimah’, to distinguish it from ‘Adam Kadmon’. And the ‘Adam Kadma’ Sati’ma became ten spheres, one within the other. And within each of these spheres, several thousand worlds were formed; and within the ‘Adam Kadma’ Sati’ma is the sphere of the Tahiro, which is the ‘Adam Kadmon’. Thereafter, the Infinite One, blessed be He, signalled to the Yud of the Sefirot to return and descend into the sphere of the Tahiro in order to create the worlds. And the Yud descended and split open the sphere of the Tahiro; for as it ascended to return to its place, the sphere of the Tahiro had closed up again, and now it split it open. And this is what Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, of blessed memory, meant when he said ‘it split and did not split’—that is to say, the splitting of the Yod is not severed; and when the Yod entered within the aforementioned Sphere of Purity, the light was embodied and became a crown of dots, encompassing the ten Sefirot of Atzilut, Z’T, within Binah; and Binah within Chokmah; and Chokmah within Keter. And because the light of the Yod of S”G was diminished, the Infinite One, blessed be He, hinted to the ‘H’ above the final Yod of S”G to illuminate the aforementioned Yod; and thereby the Yod of S”G formed the sphere of the Keter:

And know that the sphere of the Crown is much smaller than the sphere of the Tohu, and there remains much empty space within the Tohu; and the Infinite, blessed be He, alluded to the letter ‘Vav’ and the ‘D’ of the Sefirot of the Tohu, so that it might illuminate the ‘Yud’ of the Sefirot of the Tohu, and brought forth Wisdom from the Crown, alluding to the ‘Aleph’ the letter Vav of Sefirot to illuminate the letter Yud of Sefirot, and brought forth the letter Yud of Sefirot—Binah—from Chokmah; and the Infinite One, blessed be He, alluded to the letter Vav and the roots of Sefirot to illuminate the letter Yud of Sefirot, and brought forth Z’t from Binah. These are the seven kings that were broken. And it alludes to Ein Sof, blessed be He, to the Yod and Hei that remained from ‘Sefirot’, and the Hei in its full form was taken by the Keter, whilst the rest went to the other Sefirot. Thus concluded the disciples of the Ari, of blessed memory. And thus did our Master himself explain:

And the Holy One, blessed be He, signalled to the final Yud of the letter ‘S’ to descend and illuminate the vacant space; and so it did—it descended and illuminated, and that illumination almost filled the entire vacant space, whereupon it returned to its place; and it became known that every return is a judgement. Thus, from that return, a certain root came into being, and within that root was gathered the light that it had illuminated upon its descent. And it became the sphere of Tahiro, which is the Primordial Man. For ‘Tahiro Ilaya’ is the Primordial Air, and ‘Tahiro’ simply is the Primordial Man. And the Holy One, blessed be He, alluded to the ‘K’ of ‘K’T D’Alb’m’, which is the end of the garment, and caressed it upon its face. And the ‘Y’ of ‘S’G’ descended and settled between the end of the garment and the Tahiro; and as she descended for the first time into the primordial air, she took the imprint of the garment, which is the ‘Y’ of air. And when she took it to assist her as the Yod departed from the air, the light returned as it had been in the beginning; and this is the secret of ‘the light that already was’, and this is what is written in the Zohar: ‘The Yod departed from the air and the light remained.’ And now that she had descended between the end of the garment and the Tahiro, her hands were weakened and she lacked the strength to contain the point. The imprint of the garment, which is the Yud of Air, descended and became a surrounding light upon the Tahiro; and the part closest to the Yud of Sag is called ‘Primordial Air’. And the part that surrounds and touches the Tahiro is called ‘Adam Kadma’a Sitimah’, to distinguish it from ‘Adam Kadmon’. And the ‘Adam Kadma’ Sati’ma became ten spheres, one within the other. And within each of these spheres, several thousand worlds were formed; and within the ‘Adam Kadma’ Sati’ma is the sphere of the Tahiro, which is the ‘Adam Kadmon’. Thereafter, the Infinite One, blessed be He, signalled to the Yud of the Sefirot to return and descend into the sphere of the Tahiro in order to create the worlds. And the Yud descended and split open the sphere of the Tahiro; for as it ascended to return to its place, the sphere of the Tahiro had closed up again, and now it split it open. And this is what Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, of blessed memory, meant when he said ‘it split and did not split’—that is to say, the splitting of the Yod is not severed; and when the Yod entered within the aforementioned sphere of purity, the light was embodied and became a crown of dots, encompassing the ten Sefirot of Atzilut, Z’T, within Binah; and Binah within Chokmah; and Chokmah within Keter. And because the light of the Yod of S”G was diminished, the Infinite One, blessed be He, hinted to the ‘H’ above the final Yod of S”G to illuminate the aforementioned Yod; and thereby the Yod of S”G formed the sphere of the Keter:

Regarding “Tahiro Ilaya,” know that there is a distinction between “Tahiro Ilaya” and “Tahiro” in the general sense, for “Tahiro Ilaya” is that primordial air that remained after the Tzimtzum and is called “Tahiro” in the language of Targum, as is known—since “Targum” means “back”—and this air, in which the imprint of the Infinite One, blessed be He, remains, is called “the back” in relation to the light of the Infinite One. It is called “Tahiro” from the term “Shraga B’Tahira,” which refers to midday—a time that is pure, bright, and radiant, likened to midday. It is called “Eilaya” in contrast to the other “Tahiro” mentioned below, and the meaning of the term is as follows. At the very beginning of the king’s reign and authority, when he began to decree, he said, “And he established for himself then ‘Gleif Gleifo’”—that is, he conceived and engraved a holy place through the power of “Tahiro Ilaya.” That is, the very place he conceived as the dwelling place of the worlds; and “Gleifo” refers to its upper and lower extremities and its four corners. And there are those who interpret “Gleif Gleifo” as referring to the engraving of the 261 gates, which are the secret of the garment as explained; and according to this, it is clear that within the “Tahiro,” he engraved the letters within the 261 gates:

“Butzina de-Kardunita”—meaning “the strong lamp,” like “Chiti de-Kardunita,” which means Rashi, of blessed memory, as “hard wheat,” meaning that the “Butzina de-Kardunita”—which is the root of the Sefirot of Gevurot—is what sets limits and measures so that abundance does not overflow to those who are unworthy, but only in measured proportions; and it is called “Mishchata,” which is the one that measures and sets limits for all the worlds so that they do not expand beyond what is proper for them. And after He determined the place where the worlds would be, He carved thirty-one gates within that place. He explained through whom the aforementioned measure was established, stating that it was through the “Butzina de-Kardunita,” for the “Butzina de-Kardunita” is that which carves the engravings; and although there are no judgments in this lofty place, nevertheless, the root of the root of the power of judgment was present there in potential but not in actuality:

“It emerges from the hidden among the hidden”—some read “and it emerges.” And it seems to me there is another interpretation, meaning “the hidden among the hidden,” as explained by the Ari, z”l: “The hidden” is “Arich.” Since “Sitim” refers to Abba and Imma, etc., here too it is stated that this “Kutra” in the “Golma” emerges from “Sitim,” which is the primordial air called “other air,” from which half of the garment has been removed, as mentioned above. And this air is “Sitim” within other worlds below it, which are also more concealed than the lower worlds:

“The secret of Ein Sof”—we read this—and according to the version of “from the head of Ein Sof,” meaning from the Upper Head of the Upper Purity. What I understood from this, based on the teachings of the Ari, of blessed memory, is that the secret of Ein Sof is the final “yud” of the name “S”G.” And this Yud shone within another primordial air after half of the garment was removed and incorporated into its upper half, leaving room for the worlds. This holy air was so pure that the worlds lacked the power to be created within it due to its brilliance. What did this “Yud” of the Name “S”G” do? It descended and shone within that air as a dense light, so that the worlds might be able to sustain it. And although the letter Yod is from the garment itself—which is a greater light than the air, which is merely an imprint of the garment—nevertheless, since it is only a single letter, its light was dense and not as pure as the air. The reason for this is that the air is from the imprint of half of the 261 gates; therefore, its light is greater and purer than the illumination of the final Yod of the name S “G,” this Yod shone as a dense light. And afterward, it returned to ascend to its place, and then that dense light was revealed and became the sphere of the Tahiro, for every return is a judgment; therefore, through its return, that dense light which it had left behind was revealed and became the sphere of the Tahiro, which comprises ten circles, and the letter Yod ascended to the top of the Tahiro and settled there, and it is found to overlap the Tahiro. And the Yod is called “Azka,” and this is the “Kutra in the Golem”; the meaning of “Kutra” is like a pillar of smoke, whose form appears as a pillar of smoke:

We will focus on the Azka, which is the Yod of the Sefirot that overlaps the Tahiro—and this “Kutra in the Golem” is neither pale nor rosy nor of any color at all; neither judgment nor mercy is seen in it, only light in the utmost simplicity. And the explanation is as follows: It emanates from “Go Sitim,” which is the primordial air; “Sitim” refers to the worlds beneath it. And from where does the “Marza d’A”S” emanate? It is the letter Yud of the Name “S”G.” And afterward, he explained what this emanation is, saying, “Kutra b’Gulma.” That is to say, like a pillar of smoke in which only its form is visible and there is no substance to it at all; and this “Kutra begolma” is embedded in the “Azka,” which is the Yud of the Name “S”G.” And this “Kutra” is called, in the words of the Rav, z”l, “Tahiro”; this is simply how I understood it from the book “Sheber Yosef”:

And we can explain that “Butzina d’Kardinyot” is the root of the Gevurot, which emanates in a concealed manner within the concealed, as stated; and this Butzina is the “Kutra begulma”—all as stated. “Pinned in the Azka.” That is to say, this “Butzina” has one head at the “Risha d’A”S” and its second head is pinned in the Azka, which is the estimated place that is round like the Azka. And this explains what is written afterward: “As the Messiah measures, he creates colors to illuminate.” That is to say, when the aforementioned “Butzina of Kardinuta” established the measure and the Messiah for all the worlds, it “creates hues to illuminate,” for initially neither whiteness nor redness was discernible in it, but now that it has spread and extended, it “creates hues to illuminate”—namely, red, black, and white, which are the roots of judgment and mercy:
